results.title: Alpha
results.overview: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

results.name: Alpha Males
results.overview: Pedro, Luis, Raúl and Santi are four friends who feel a bit lost in the new world of empowered women, each trying to adjust in their own haphazard way.

results.name: Alpha House
results.overview: Four Republican senators share the same D.C. house rental, and face re-election battles, looming indictments, and parties -- all with a sense of humor.

results.title: Alpha
results.overview: Alpha, a troubled 13-year-old lives with her single mom. Their world collapses the day she returns from school with a tattoo on her arm.

results.title: Alpha
results.overview: In the prehistoric past, Keda, a young and inexperienced hunter, struggles to return home after being separated from his tribe when bison hunting goes awry. On his way back he will find an unexpected ally.

results.name: Alpha Alpha
results.overview: Alpha Alpha was a 1972 German science fiction fantasy television series which aired on ZDF. It starred Karl Michael Vogler, Lilith Ungerer, Arthur Brauss and Horst Sachtleben. Each episode was only 25 minutes long, the series lasted only one season. Karl Michael Vogler played agent alpha of an unnamed secret organization, investigating mysteries, technical and psychic phenomena and even alien encounters. Alpha Alpha's tenor is comparable to the later X-Files drama television series.

results.title: Alpha Dog
results.overview: Johnny Truelove likes to see himself as tough. He's the son of an underworld figure and a drug dealer. Johnny also likes to get tough when things don't go his way. When Jake Mazursky fails to pay up for Johnny, things get worse for the Mazursky family, as Johnny and his 'gang' kidnap Jake's 15 year old brother and hold him hostage.

results.name: Alpha Beta
results.overview:
Based on Gao Ming's 2010  book "Genius on the Left, Lunatic on the Right," Letv's 2015 web series "Alpha Beta" delves into the complexities of mental illness. Featuring Jordan Chan, Alan Kuo, Stephy Tang, and Cherrie Ying, the narrative revolves around a psychiatrist, a couple grappling with mental health issues, and their interactions with various mental health patients.

Just before their wedding, Gao Kai's fiancée Tian Xin suffers a car accident that leaves her mute. Her cousin, psychiatrist Li Shi Hui, is optimistic about Tian Xin's recovery. However, upon returning to her job, Shi Hui is suffers severe headaches and hallucinations, leading her to lash out at her supervisor. During her assessment at Shi Hui's facility, Tian Xin reveals a remarkable talent for soothing a volatile patient. Consequently, Shi Hui decides to harness Tian Xin's unique ability to assist in the treatment of other patients burdened by their traumatic pasts and internal struggles.

results.title: Alpha
results.overview: In a world with no humans, what will you do when you meet one?

results.title: Alpha.
results.overview: After his mother passes away, Rein moves to a small village in the Alps to be immersed in nature, meditate and work as a snowboard teacher. His quiet bubble bursts when his extroverted father Gijs comes to visit. But it isn’t long before Rein has had enough.

results.title: Alpha and Omega
results.overview: Two young wolves at opposite ends of their pack's social order are thrown together into a foreign land and need each other to return home, but love complicates everything.

results.name: Project Alpha
results.overview:
Twenty-seven trainees compete for coveted idol positions on GMMTV's roster of artists.

Among the competitors, four Alphas are selected and grouped together. The remaining competitors are split into Beta groups. Each week, the groups fight either to keep their positions as Alpha or to break out of the Beta role and to stay in the competition altogether.

results.name: Fort Alpha
results.overview:
While the original 1996 series was set in a secondary school, the new version shifts the story to a vocational college: Fort Alpha. When the renowned, provincial Fort Alpha merges with the urban MBO Oostland, two vastly different worlds collide.

This divide quickly ignites a fierce conflict, putting friendships, relationships, and the future of Fort Alpha and its students at stake.

results.name: RoboCop: Alpha Commando
results.overview: RoboCop: Alpha Commando was a short-lived animated series based on the Orion Pictures film RoboCop and the series/films that followed in the 1980s-1990s. It was the second animated version of the character, following on from RoboCop: The Animated Series.

results.name: Alpha Girls
results.overview: When their father, Alpha, calls them home to Indonesia, Sierra, and Ivy, two sisters from different mothers, realize who can revive the declining Alpha company and will replace him as leader. Something that not only Sierra and Ivy wanted, but also their respective mothers, who were Alpha's first and second wives, two ambitious women who could never get along, who also raised their respective two ambitious girls. The battle is about to start!

results.title: Alpha Test
results.overview: A young detective must solve a murder with the help of a hologram copy of the victim.

results.title: Alpha House
results.overview: When two freshmen pledges are accepted into the biggest party frat on campus, they think they have it all. That is, until the assistant dean forces the Alphas to share their house with a sorority or face expulsion from school. Not wanting to see their lifelong dream of becoming Alphas destroyed, the pledges convince the other members of the house to take back what's theirs, waging an epic battle of the sexes to fight for their right to party.
